answer: Bind every identity to one hardware enclave: to earn, an agent must present a fresh remote attestation proving a unique key that never leaves its device. Each extra fake therefore costs the farm another piece of copper and silicon, not just code — a cost that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bulk-bought, because one enclave key serves one identity only, and any key that signs twice lands on a public revocation list. The farm's bill spirals with every fake, and at the zenith of the scheme it is still one device per fake.
